title: Company Intent Radar input
description: List company websites. Each one gets a short report of buying-intent signals: hiring, Google ads, SEO traffic and email provider.

domains.title: Company domains
domains.description: Array of strings. In the Console UI: one per line. Company websites, for example "stripe.com". Full URLs are fine too. Up to 100 per run.

country.title: Country for SEO traffic
country.description: Two-letter country code for the organic traffic estimate, for example US, GB or DE. Default: US.

include_jobs.title: Include newest job titles
include_jobs.description: Add the 5 newest job titles to each report.
